integrity: The proof is analytic and uses exact ball cross-sections, a uniform small-cap expansion, scale localization of maximizers, and an explicit limiting one-variable optimization. Numerical maximization was used only as a sanity check and is not part of the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a far-field asymptotic for the Euclidean unit ball in dimensions n>=4. It does not give finite-radius uniqueness or a quantitative remainder, and it does not cover arbitrary radial data or convex bodies. The full motivating preprint was not retrievable in this run, leaving a residual originality-comparison risk recorded in the review.
title: Far-field boundary layer for centered maximal averages of a ball
